title: The Frozen Lake
text: The way crosses a frozen lake, the ice black and clear and thick as a wall. Something under it is moving. A long pale shape slides beneath your feet, slow and patient, and it follows whoever it has marked.

options.label: The one enemies always find goes first, to draw it away from the others.

outcomes.text: It follows them under the ice, nose to their boots, and the others cross safe behind.
It breaks the ice beneath them, and the water is black and very cold.

options.label: Spread out and walk light, and hope it cannot follow you all.

outcomes.text: Slow, careful, cold, with the pale shape sliding under one of you, then another.

options.label: Cut a hole and bait it, and see what rises.

outcomes.text: It bites, and it is much bigger than the hole.
